messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert fired for service `inference-api` (INC-2026-3345). Symptoms: elevated 5xx rate and p99 latency spike in us-west-2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2026-3345
pd-bot: Auto-assigning page to Liam (primary oncall). Escalation policy: infra-rotation.
Liam: Acked. I'm on it — starting quick triage.
pagerbot: Note: automatic reassignment triggered by rotation rule -> assigned to Marcus due to overlapping rotation window.
Marcus: I didn't get the initial PD page modal, just saw the reassign. @Liam are you still owning or should I take?
Liam: I acked first, but PD moved assignment. I'll handover to @Marcus — brief context: 502/5xx coming from model-proxy layer for streaming endpoints, spike started ~2m ago.
Liam: Quick data: 
```
# slow query: top errors last 5m
service=inference-api component=model-proxy status=502 count=324
region=us-west-2 requests/s +120%
```
Liam: Looks correlated with a heavy internal batch that kicked off at the same time.
Rina: I can help with mitigation (routing/fallback). Which customers impacted? Any PII?
Liam: Customers "AcmeCorp" and "BetaLabs" reported failed requests in support tickets. No PII seen in logs. Embeddings pipeline seems unaffected but streaming gen endpoints degraded.
Marcus: Running quick cluster checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-proxy -o wide`
```
model-proxy-7d9c    2/2 Running   0     3m   10.0.48.12   us-west-2a
model-proxy-9f2b    1/2 CrashLoopBackOff  4  2m  10.0.48.14   us-west-2b
```
Marcus: One replica is CrashLooping and others at CPU ~95%. OOM spikes in proxy logs.
Rina: Suggest immediate mitigation: route small % of traffic to fallback model variant (fallback-quantized-v1) and scale up model-proxy replicas + increase CPU for proxy. Per runbook: https://confluence.example/runbook/inference-proxy-fallback
Liam: +1 to fallback. I'll open routing change.
Liam: Applying routing short-circuit now: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/route 
 -d '{"service":"inference-api","route":"fallback-quantized-v1","percent":30}' 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Marcus: I bumped HPA minReplicas to 4 and increased requests.cpu to 500m for model-proxy. Watching pods recreate.
Sasha: Notified support leads and customers A & B on the support thread. They're aware we're mitigating; asked for timestamps of failed requests.
pagerbot: PD note: multiple ack events detected for INC-2026-3345 (Liam -> Marcus). Please confirm single owner for communications.
Marcus: I'll take ownership formally. @Liam handing off. I'll be the point for incident comms and bridge. Updating PD assignment now.
pd-bot: Incident ownership updated to Marcus. Please annotate timeline and start incident bridge if needed.
Marcus: Fallback routing applied successfully, errors dropping. Quick metric: 5xx rate down from 120/min -> 12/min in last 90s. p99 latency improving. Monitoring for 10m then we'll consider traffic ramp.
Rina: Good. I'll queue a temporary alert threshold adjustment to avoid noise while we stabilize.
Liam: Thanks — handing any followups to @Marcus. I'll standby for post-incident review.
Sasha: Confirmed customers A & B received interim update. No new reports in last 3m.
Marcus: Continuing to investigate root cause (suspect memory regression in model-proxy after recent deploy). Will look at recent deploys and container image diff.
pd-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Owner: Marcus. Severity: P1 -> maintaining.
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation showing improvement. If stable for 15m we'll update to 'monitoring' and start incident writeup.
Marcus: I'll prepare timeline and RCA draft. @Rina please add ops mitigation steps to postmortem.
Liam: Thanks all — handing off fully.
Marcus: Marking intent to close after 15m stable and follow-up postmortem items assigned.
pd-bot: Incident updated: status -> monitoring. Owner: Marcus.
pagerbot: Closing note scheduled; please file postmortem ticket INC-2026-3345-PR for RCA and customer comms.
